master:
Use case: stylized-concept, game terrain asset, detailed reference-guided image edit. Create ONE continuous 2048x2816 portrait master terrain painting. Image 1 is the EXACT placement guide: replace the flat blue river and grey bank marks with a spectacular fully painted river. Image 2 is the existing game ground under it, which must stay consistent. Image 3 is the camp's established art style and ground-detail scale: charming polished hand-painted top-down RPG terrain, individual faceted pebbles, shallow dimensional shading and crisp illustrative edges. Image 4 is the user's overview, for the blue water, rocky cascades and geography only, NOT for copying its forests or buildings.

Preserve the portrait composition, camera height, surrounding brown earth material and small stone size from images 1 and 2. Keep all left/right outer 160 pixels and bottom 100 pixels ordinary brown ground, no black vignette, no frames. River starts OPEN at the top at x=556, flows down to about (656,1000), curves southeast through (1256,1600), then south into a wide final pool at (1570,2510), remaining above y=2710. Follow this overall route with naturally irregular curving banks, no ruler-straight channels or hard polygon corners. River width around 260px, with varied widths 190-350px and wider pools. Three coherent reaches: top narrow blue rocky headwater with small stepping cascades, middle gorgeous white foaming waterfall ledge into a deep clear blue plunge pool and right-hand bend, lower flowing south bend ending in a beautiful rounded rocky pool for later expansion. Show mostly top-down water with only short visible waterfall faces, no steep side-view landscape.

Rich blue-grey / steel blue water, deeper blue centre, subtle pale turquoise shallow margins revealing submerged stones, elegant currents and little eddies. Sculpted irregular grey/brown rock clusters anchor banks and waterfall ledges. Clear warm lighting from upper left, short soft contact shadows, bright foam at ledges, wet darker dirt along banks graduating softly into EXISTING brown earth with scattered gravel. Crisp handmade dimensional game art at the SAME SIZE of detail as image 3. Preserve enough open unadorned brown earth beyond banks so later trees and bushes can be placed as separate assets.

NO trees, bushes, grass clumps, flowers, giant leaves, foliage, green-tinted soil, buildings, roads, bridges, characters, labels, grids, borders, black fades, UI or photorealism. Do not make a glossy 3D render. Do not change the outer ground into another texture. Output the entire continuous master, not separate panels.
motion: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent WATER ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for a polished hand-painted top-down survival game. Create exactly one square 1024x1024 RGBA image, divided into a precise 4-column by 4-row grid of sixteen equal 256x256 animation cells, read left to right then top to bottom. No visible grid lines or labels. Every cell shows the SAME small cluster of delicate pale icy-blue and white flowing river ripples, tiny foam filaments and soft curved glints, on a genuinely transparent background. Very sparse design: transparent space covers at least 80 percent of each cell. A few wispy horizontal broken highlights and small curling eddies; no large white blobs. Top-down painted water movement. Across the sixteen frames, the same highlights gently travel downward in tiny steps and dissolve as new highlights appear, making a seamless flowing-water loop. Keep a 20px completely empty margin inside every cell so cells cannot bleed. Consistent lighting, scale and stroke weight. Smooth illustrative brush strokes, subtle cool blue-grey shading in the foam, crisp edges. This will be composited over already-painted blue river water, so draw ONLY the moving foam/glints. NO water rectangle, NO terrain, rocks, plants, shoreline, shadows, text, checkerboard, horizon, opaque background or UI.
